memory_candidates: VecEA2 bracket witnesses are guaranteed to be between endpoints by construction. For encoding 'exists y between t and x', use BracketFormula with pointTypes for y's predicates and segmentTypes for interval guards. This avoids the backward-direction failure of Since(char_y, top) at x which finds y anywhere below x.

The zone-aware enriched formula distributes y-conditions across the Until structure: endpointLeft handles y < t and y = t zones at t; endpointRight handles y = x and y > x zones at x; bracket handles t < y < x zone with guaranteed witnesses between endpoints.

For negative between_tx conditions (sub_nf.2 ssn = false): if ssn is in zone between_tx and xt-compatible, then no y in (t,x) has the predicates of nf_y_proj ssn (because the order atoms match in (t,x) but the overall NF is unsatisfied, so predicates must fail). This justifies neg char_y in the segment guard.
ssn_zone_until classifies depth-0 3-var NFs into zones based on y-t and y-x order atoms. The zone determines where the ssn's temporal encoding goes in the enriched formula structure.
